scoring_notes: Hard PDF gate applied: ranks 51, 52, 54, 55, 58 lack a real full PDF; capped coverage <= 6 (rank 54 reaches 6 only because PMC OAI-PMH JATS XML provides the full body text and all tables/equations).
Ranks 53, 56, 57, 59, 60, 61 have local full PDFs (confirmed by pdftotext and admin pdf_score_readiness for rank 61) and are scored against the report+artifact contents, not regex/substring.
Coverage is paper-fraction reproduced; accuracy is agreement on the covered subset (high accuracy with low coverage is the common shape for PASS-low/partial-table replications).

Mean coverage 3.82 and mean accuracy 6.45 for ranks 51-61 are weighted down by 4 papers with no full PDF (51, 52, 55, 58) plus 1 wet-lab triage (59); the 'first_pass_partial' or stronger cluster (54, 56, 57, 60, 61) averages coverage ~5.6, accuracy ~8.2.
